root_cause: The persisted high-risk regression asset contains only question and answer fields. It does not contain the FinQA financial context or table required to answer the questions.
decision: Do not use this run to accept or reject the frozen step 724 adapter. Rebuild the high-risk asset with contexts joined from the matching FinQA test rows, then rerun all 91 rows.
fix: prepare_assets now enriches every Aiera verified row with pre_text, post_text, table, and qa from the matching FinQA test row and fails if any question cannot be matched.
